correctness.rationale: Every fixed state with hub zero is in bijection with a cyclic word of original rim bits containing no 101 and at most floor(n/2) ones, by the forced subdivision bits y_i=x_i OR x_(i+1). A marked-run composition yields the precise double binomial sum. The weighted four-state matrix excludes exactly transition 101; a symbolic determinant check gives det(I-tT)=1-(1+z)t+zt^2-zt^3, and implicit Perron differentiation yields mean one-density 0.4114955887<1/2 and the exponential tail bound. Distinct standalone full graph checks cover 174720 configurations for n=3..8, and transfer/run arrays agree for n=3..45; the infinite proof does not rely on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Uniform edge subdivision of the standard wheel creates an exponential entropy of immediately fixed majority states versus the two unanimity fixed states on ordinary wheels. The new degree-two layer is uniquely forced by adjacent original rim bits, and the resulting no-isolated-zero automaton has a typical one-density strictly below the hub threshold, hence a pure exponential with no square-root factor. This structural mechanism and exact all-parameter labelled enumeration contrast with the related helm leaf-decorated system, where a central constraint contributes a square-root penalty.
